source: IMGeo 2.2 reference model: gesloten verharding and open verharding of bgt-fysiekVoorkomen, and as optional the plus-fysiekVoorkomen values whose parent is one of them
note: Origin: question of 20 November 2026 for the comparison without and with the metadata and MIM skills. The working group chose gesloten verharding and open verharding, in line with dsfl-16; a finer IMGeo plus value under one of them, such as asfalt or tegels, is allowed. Half verhard, onverhard and their plus values count as wrong.
